comment: NIST CAVP SHA-256 test vectors for byte-oriented implementations (Secure Hash Algorithm Validation System), byte for byte as members of the archive NIST publishes. ShortMsg holds 65 messages of 0 to 64 bytes and their digests; Monte holds the seed and 100 checkpoints of the SHAVS Monte Carlo test. generators/snapshot's shashort and shamonte hash every one with the SHA-256 the snapshot address uses (Sha256, FIPS 180-4) and refuse any difference (GN-01). LongMsg is not vendored yet: it is 426 KB, over the request bound.
standard: FIPS 180-4 Secure Hash Standard, SHA-256; NIST SHAVS
